limitations: Only finite sums of polynomial amplitudes times linear exponentials are treated. The theorem does not settle arbitrary exponential-type pluriharmonic symbols or boundedness of all generators on the full Fock space.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, reproducibility material where present, and dated review evidence are listed in the research and audit files.
record_title: Finite-frequency pluriharmonic Fock Toeplitz operators form a zero-divisor-free algebra
